website_images_scraper.description: Website Images Scraper extracts image URLs and hosting domains from any web page. Submit any passage with your chosen target tense to receive the transformed wording and a flag indicating whether the text changed. Tense Converter works by analyzing the text provided and converting it to the past or future tense.

text.description: The text to convert to past or future tense

tense.description: The tense to convert the text to. default past. One of: past, future

output.description: The data object: tense, result, changed.

text_language.title: Text Language
text_language.description: Text Language detects the language of any input string, returning the full language name and its two-letter ISO 639-1 code. Send plain text passages or short snippets to identify incoming multilingual content. Text Language works by analyzing the text and comparing it to a database of languages and ai models.

text.description: The text to detect the language of

output.description: The data object: language, iso.

text_lemmatizer.title: Text Lemmatizer
text_lemmatizer.description: Text Lemmatizer reduces inflected words in submitted text down to their dictionary base forms. It confirms when valid lemmas exist, while paid plans return full word-by-word mappings. Lemmatizer works by analyzing the text provided and lemmatizing it.

text.description: The text to lemmatize

output.description: The data object: found, lemmas.

text_readability_score.title: Text Readability Score
text_readability_score.description: Text Readability Score calculates the readability score and grade level of any text across standard formulas. It returns Flesch Reading Ease, Gunning Fog, Coleman-Liau, syllable and word counts, an average grade level, and a target audience label. Readability Score works by analyzing the text provided and calculating the readability score.

text.description: The text to calculate the readability score of

output.description: The data object: textCounts, readability, readabilityText, averageGradeLevel, targetAudience.

text_similarity.title: Text Similarity
text_similarity.description: Text Similarity compares two text strings and calculates their percentage match score. It returns case-insensitive and case-sensitive similarity scores plus the count and proportion of differing words. Text Similarity works by comparing the two texts and calculating the similarity score based on various factors.

text1.description: The first text to compare. Must be less than 1000 characters

text2.description: The second text to compare. Must be less than 1000 characters

output.description: The data object: simiarity, similarityCaseSensitive, difference.

text_styler.title: Text Styler
text_styler.description: Text Styler converts plain text into styled text formats like bubble letters, strikethrough, typewriter, and vaporwave. Submit your string with a chosen style to receive the formatted text output. Submit a text string and a target style name such as underline, mirror, creepify, or wingdings.

text.description: The text to style

style.description: The style to apply. One of: strikeThrough, wingdings, vaporwave, typewriter, analucia, tildeStrikeThrough, underline, doubleUnderline, slashThrough, sparrow, heartsBetween, arrowBelow, crossAboveBelow, creepify, bubbles, mirror, squares, roundsquares, flip, tiny

output.description: The data object: style, text.

text_summarizer.title: Text Summarizer
text_summarizer.description: Text Summarizer condenses raw text into concise summaries of a specified sentence count. Pass up to 5,000 characters to extract key points into readable summaries, with paid plans adding word counts and reduction metrics. Text Summarizer works by analyzing the text provided and generating a concise summary.

text.description: The text to summarize (up to 5000 characters). length 0-50000

sentences.description: The length of the summary (number of sentences). default 3

output.description: The data object: originalWords, summaryWords, percentDifference, summary.

text_to_emoji.title: Text to Emoji
text_to_emoji.description: Text to Emoji converts plain text strings into matching emoji representations. Send any word or phrase and receive the corresponding emoji characters. Submit a text string in the POST request body.

text.description: The text you want converted into emojis

output.description: The data object: emojis.

title_case_converter.title: Title Case Converter
title_case_converter.description: Title Case Converter formats text strings into specific editorial style guidelines and capitalization standards. Send raw headline text and a chosen rule set like APA, Chicago, or AP to receive properly capitalized copy. Title Capitalization works by analyzing the title text provided and converting it to various cases.

text.description: The text to convert to title case

style.description: The case to convert the text to. One of: apa, chicago, ap, mla, nyt, ama, bb, wikipedia, email, title-case, sentence-case, uppercase, lowercase, first-letter, alt-case, toggle-case

output.description: The data object: style, text.

translator.title: Translator
translator.description: Translator translates written text into target languages using standard language codes. Submit any string with a target language code to receive the translated text and the confirmed or auto-detected source language. Translator works by using machine translation to convert text from one language to another.

text.description: The text to translate. length 0-50000

target.description: The language code to translate the text to (e.g., fr, es, de). length 0-10

source.description: The language code of the text to translate (e.g., en). If left blank, language will be auto-detected

output.description: The data object: sourceLang, targetLang, translatedText.

vowel_counter.title: Vowel Counter
vowel_counter.description: Vowel Counter analyzes text to count vowels and consonants, providing detailed breakdowns and percentages for linguistic analysis. Perfect for linguistic research, readability analysis, and educational applications requiring detailed phonetic character analysis.

text.description: Text to analyze (max 50,000 characters)

output.description: The data object: vowels, consonants, totalLetters, vowelPercentage, consonantPercentage, vowelBreakdown, textLength.

website_readability.title: Website Readability
website_readability.description: Website Readability analyzes live web pages to score their reading difficulty and educational grade level. It returns Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid grade level, word count, sentence count, and estimated reading time. Website Readability works by fetching the page, extracting its readable text and scoring it across standard readability indices (Flesch, Gunning Fog, SMOG, Coleman-Liau, ARI, Dale-Chall).

url.description: The URL of the web page to analyze.

output.description: The data object: fleschReadingEase, fleschReadingEaseText, fleschKincaidGrade, gunningFog, colemanLiauIndex, smogIndex, automatedReadabilityIndex, daleChallReadabilityScore, daleChallReadabilityScoreText, wordCount, sentenceCount, readingTimeMinutes, and more.

word_lexicon_analyzer.title: Word Lexicon Analyzer
word_lexicon_analyzer.description: Word Lexicon Analyzer inspects any single word to check linguistic properties including palindromes, isograms, and Scrabble validity. It identifies anagram potential, alphagram status, and sorted letter forms. Pass any target string to the endpoint to evaluate its letter arrangement, repetition, and dictionary status.

output.description: The data object: word, isAlphagram, sortedForm, isPalindrome, hasAnagram, isIsogram, isPangramCandidate, isScrabbleValid, canBePalindromeAnagram.

word_opposites.title: Word Opposites
word_opposites.description: Word Opposites looks up direct antonyms for any single input term. Pass an English word to receive an array of contrasting and opposing words. Submit a single word in the query string.

word.description: The word to get the opposites for

output.description: The data object: word, opposites.

word_pronunciation.title: Word Pronunciation
word_pronunciation.description: Word Pronunciation retrieves the phonetic pronunciation of any English word in ARPAbet format. Pass a word to receive its phonetic transcription for speech synthesis, dictionaries, or language tools. Word Pronunciation works by analyzing the word provided and getting the pronunciation.

word.description: The word to get the pronunciation of

output.description: The data object: word, pronounciation.

airline_lookup.title: Airline Lookup
airline_lookup.description: Airline Lookup matches IATA codes and airline names to carrier profiles, returning the official title, callsign, registration country, and low-cost status. Paid tiers add three-letter ICAO code lookups and carrier logo URLs. Submit a two-letter IATA code or airline name to query a directory of over 5,000 airlines updated weekly.

iata.description: The IATA code of the airline for which you want to get the information (e.g., AA)

output.description: The data object of the response.

airport_code_converter.title: Airport Code Converter
airport_code_converter.description: Airport Code Converter converts between 3-letter IATA and 4-letter ICAO airport codes. Submit either identifier to receive the matching code, official airport name, city, state, and country code. Airport Code Converter automatically detects whether you've submitted an IATA or ICAO code based on length, then returns the corresponding code in the other format.

code.description: The airport code to convert (IATA: 3 letters, ICAO: 4 letters)

output.description: The data object: input, inputType, iata, icao, name, city, state, country, elevation, latitude, longitude, timezone, and more.

airport_distance.title: Airport Distance
airport_distance.description: Airport Distance calculates great-circle flight distances and travel times between two airports using their 3-letter IATA codes. It provides route distance in miles and kilometers plus estimated flight duration. Supply two airport IATA codes to calculate the great-circle route distance in statute miles and kilometers together with estimated flight duration.

iata1.description: The IATA code of the first airport (e.g. JFK)

iata2.description: The IATA code of the second airport (e.g. LAX)

output.description: The data object: distanceMiles, distanceKm, distanceNauticalMiles, estimatedFlightTime, timezoneDiffHours, bearing, direction, isInternational, carbonEstimateKg, airport1, airport2.

airports_lookup.title: Airports Lookup
airports_lookup.description: Airports Lookup resolves 3-letter IATA codes into official airport names, matching ICAO codes, cities, states, and country codes. Paid plans add ICAO code lookups, geographic coordinates, elevation, and local timezones across more than 40,000 facilities. Query the database by passing a 3-letter IATA code to retrieve the airport's official name, state, city, and country code.

iata.description: The IATA code of the airport for which you want to get the information (e.g., MCI)

output.description: The data object: icao, iata, name, city, state, country, elevation, lat, lon, tz, city_info.

us_car_models.title: US Car Models
us_car_models.description: US Car Models provides comprehensive data on vehicles sold in the United States. Returns detailed specifications including fuel economy (MPG), engine details, transmission, and more for cars from 1984 to present. Data is sourced from the EPA's official fuel economy database (fueleconomy.gov) and updated weekly.
us_car_models.notes: Premium-only arguments (ignored or rejected on the free plan): year, trim.

make.description: The make (manufacturer) of the car (e.g., Toyota, Honda, Ford)

year.description: Filter by year (1984-present). range 1984-2030. Premium field (paid plans only).

model.description: Narrow to a model name (e.g., Camry)

trim.description: Narrow to a trim level (e.g., Hybrid). Premium field (paid plans only).

output.description: The data object: count, filteredOn.

vin_decoder.title: VIN Decoder
vin_decoder.description: VIN Decoder turns a 17-character Vehicle Identification Number into the vehicle it identifies. Returns make, model, year, trim, body class and manufacturer, plus engine specifications, plant of manufacture, and the safety equipment fitted to that specific build. Data is sourced from the NHTSA vPIC database, the official US vehicle identification record, and is refreshed with each monthly release.

vin.description: The Vehicle Identification Number to decode. Partial VINs are accepted and decode as far as the available characters allow.. length 1-17

output.description: The data object: vin, valid, decoded, vehicleDescriptor, make, model, year, trim, trim2, series, series2, manufacturer, and more.

air_quality.title: Air Quality
air_quality.description: Air Quality reports particulate pollution levels and health recommendations for any city or zip code. Look up PM2.5 and PM10 concentrations to check current air conditions; paid plans add ozone, toxic gases, and EPA index scores. Air Quality works by retrieving the air quality data from various reliable sources and providing it in a structured format.

city.description: The city name for which you want to get the air quality data (e.g., New York)

output.description: The data object: pm2_5, pm10, carbonMonoxide, ozone, nitrogenDioxide, sulfurdioxide, usEpaIndex, gbDefraIndex, recommendation, city.

marine_weather.title: Marine Weather
marine_weather.description: Marine Weather fetches offshore weather conditions for any marine coordinates by latitude and longitude. Each response details high and low temperatures, maximum wind speeds, precipitation totals, humidity, UV index, and sunrise and sunset times. Marine Weather works by retrieving the marine weather data from various reliable weather sources and providing it in a structured format.

lat.description: The latitude coordinate of the location. range -90-90

lon.description: The longitude coordinate of the location. range -180-180

output.description: The data object: location, weather.

moonrise_moonset.title: Moonrise Moonset
moonrise_moonset.description: Moonrise Moonset calculates exact moonrise and moonset times for any geographic coordinate. It outputs ISO 8601 timestamps for lunar rise and set events, with paid plans adding moon phase details and date selection. Moonrise Moonset works by analyzing the location provided and getting the moonrise and moonset times.
moonrise_moonset.notes: Premium-only arguments (ignored or rejected on the free plan): date.

lat.description: The latitude of the location. range -90-90

lon.description: The longitude of the location. range -180-180

date.description: The date to get the moonrise and moonset times for (MM-dd-yyyy). date. Premium field (paid plans only).

output.description: The data object: coordinates, phase, moonrise, moonset, moonAlwaysUp, moonAlwaysDown.

solar_potential.title: Solar Potential
solar_potential.description: Solar Potential calculates solar energy potential for any latitude and longitude coordinates. It returns average daily usable sunlight hours and optimal panel orientation, with paid plans adding yearly totals and cloud factors. Pass geographic coordinates to receive average daily usable sunlight hours and the optimal compass orientation for photovoltaic panels.

lat.description: The latitude of the location. range -90-90

lon.description: The longitude of the location. range -180-180

output.description: The data object: coordinates, usableHours, bestDirection, cloudFactor, disclaimer.

sunrise_sunset.title: Sunrise Sunset
sunrise_sunset.description: Sunrise Sunset calculates exact sunrise and sunset times, twilight stages, and golden hour windows for any latitude and longitude coordinates. Paid plans can specify custom dates and receive solar noon. Sunrise Sunset works by calculating the sunrise and sunset times based on the location and date provided.
sunrise_sunset.notes: Premium-only arguments (ignored or rejected on the free plan): date.

lat.description: The latitude of the location. range -90-90

lon.description: The longitude of the location. range -180-180

date.description: The date for which you want to get the sunrise and sunset times (e.g., MM-DD-YYYY : 01-01-2022). date. Premium field (paid plans only).

output.description: The data object: solarNoon, sunrise, sunset, sunriseEnd, sunsetStart, dawn, dusk, nauticalDawn, nauticalDusk, nightEnd, night, goldenHourEnd, and more.

weather.title: Weather
weather.description: Weather reports current weather conditions and a 7-day forecast for any city name or zip code. It provides real-time temperature and wind speed along with compass direction in both metric and imperial units, plus daily highs, lows, rain chance and conditions for the week ahead. Query either a city name or a zip code to fetch real-time atmospheric readings.

city.description: The city for which you want to get the current weather (e.g., San Francisco)

forecast.description: Included by default. Set to false to omit the 7-day forecast and return current conditions only.

output.description: The data object: tempC, tempF, windMph, windKph, windDegree, windDir, pressureMb, pressureIn, precipMm, precipIn, feelslikeC, feelslikeF, and more.

weather_seasons.title: Weather Seasons
weather_seasons.description: Weather Seasons calculates astronomical solstice and equinox dates for any target year. It provides exact timestamps and reference timezones for the March and September equinoxes and the June and December solstices. Weather Seasons works by calculating the dates of the solstice and equinox for a given year.

year.description: The year to get the dates of the solstice and equinox. default 2025. range 1900-2100

output.description: The data object: year, timezone, march_equinox, june_solstice, september_equinox, december_solstice.

worldwide_earthquakes.title: Worldwide Earthquakes
worldwide_earthquakes.description: Worldwide Earthquakes tracks global seismic activity recorded over the past hour. It delivers magnitudes, epicenter coordinates, location names, tsunami warning flags, and 24-hour activity summaries sourced from the USGS. Requests pull seismic records refreshed hourly from the United States Geological Survey.

output.description: The data object: earthquakes_LastUpdated, earthquakes_LastHour, count24h, largestMagnitude24h, avgMagnitude24h.
